pages.task: Run an isolated offline demo from start to stop
Settings, live sessions, invitations and headless audio
Find implementation files and relevant checks
Recover from a failed JSON command
Inspect authenticated HTTP and WebSocket protocols
Understand tested behavior and remaining hardware checks

commands.name: catalog
commands.summary: Return this offline command catalog; no runtime or files are required.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Discover the runtime. Missing runtime succeeds with running:false. Running status includes settings, session metadata and caption_count, without transcript text.

commands.name: runtime-start
commands.summary: Start a detached runtime without opening a browser or starting a session/audio. Source startup may build missing assets.

commands.name: runtime-stop
commands.summary: Request authenticated shutdown and wait for that runtime to stop.

commands.name: settings-get
commands.summary: Read current preferences and provider configuration metadata; never return API keys.

commands.name: settings-set
commands.summary: Update preferences from {expected_revision:integer,settings:object}; maximum UTF-8 input size is 32768 bytes.

commands.name: session-create
commands.summary: Create an idle conversation; an explicit demo/live mode is required. This does not start capture or providers.

commands.name: session-start
commands.summary: Prepare an existing conversation. Demo starts synthetic PCM; live mode waits for a participant and does not capture the PC.

commands.name: session-stop
commands.summary: Stop a conversation, release audio/providers and discard its in-memory captions.

commands.name: session-snapshot
commands.summary: Read current conversation state and the latest captions (default10). caption_count is the total retained; captions_truncated reports omitted older entries.

commands.name: invite-create
commands.summary: Return a sensitive, one-use, ten-minute participant invite URL. Share it only with the intended participant.

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.summary: Read runtime diagnostics without API keys or transcript text.

commands.name: devices
commands.summary: Enumerate native PC audio output devices; this does not start capture.

commands.name: secret-set
commands.summary: Read a non-empty plaintext UTF-8 key from stdin/file, maximum 4096 bytes. Memory-only by default; never echo the key.

commands.name: provider-test
commands.summary: Explicitly contact the configured provider; usage may be incurred. ngrok validation is performed by tunnel-start.

commands.name: tunnel-start
commands.summary: Explicitly publish the participant Hub with the configured ngrok account and domain.

commands.name: tunnel-stop
commands.summary: Stop the currently owned public tunnel.

commands.name: audio-share
commands.summary: Share the selected PC output for a bounded duration, keep the authenticated owner heartbeat alive, then stop owned capture.
